description: This PHP class defines the data transfer object (DTO) for search filter parameters related to PayGrade entities in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and specifies allowed sorting fields, setting a default sort field upon instantiation.

classes.name: PayGradeSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class used for encapsulating search filter parameters specifically for pay grade searches within the OrangeHRM system. It restricts sorting to particular fields and sets a default sort criterion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters by setting the default sort field to 'pg.name'.
